naturalFeature.note: State GIS #139 and #140 are different waterfalls. Upper field point differs from GIS; avoid routing by ambiguous map pins.

publicLand.note: Visit Keweenaw identifies the lower falls as state land; regional reporting credits DNR and The Nature Conservancy with a published alternate public approach. This does not establish every intervening parcel or current gate.

seasonalArrival.note: 2026–27 Keweenaw visitor guide directs via Mandan Road to Fish Cove, while the 2023 visitor article identifies a rustic parking area. A 2024 DNR/TNC-reported alternative uses Hoar Lake Loop then leaves the vehicle before a berm. These are distinct descriptions, not verified interchangeable parking coordinates.

walkingCorridor.note: Visit Keweenaw describes about one mile on an unmarked rocky shoreline track from Fish Cove to Lower Montreal. Regional 2024 coverage describes a 1.3 mile unnamed-road walk on a separate approach. Neither is a current signed/maintained route or a measured route to Upper Montreal.

currentConditions.note: No November 2026 official public road/parking/gate and uninterrupted foot corridor status established; do not claim winter driving, current opening, GPS parking or safe shoreline passage.

newConstruction.note: KORC west-bank parking/connector proposed since 2022 and still subject to approval in March 2026. DNR/Copper Harbor Trails Club east-bank Montreal Corridor is a different approved/under-construction trail phase in 2026; its future waterfall access is not available merely because construction has begun.
